Title: Enforce service draft moderation transitions and explicit rate/role boundaries

Given/When/Then:

Given an authenticated provider or merchant, when they submit a create or update payload attempting to set status=approved directly, then the server rejects the mutation (400 or 403) and preserves status=draft.

Observed defect (src/lib/sponsorMatcher.ts): candidate.id is checked with a RegExp without verifying typeof candidate.id === 'string'.
